scope: Actuator controller and button interface only; user chose Altium arrangement with a separate GPIO cable
controller: SparkFun WRL-15663 ESP32 Thing Plus Micro-B

sources.evidence: Viewed official schematic image: GPIO32/33 on header J2; A1=GPIO25 and A0=GPIO26 on J4; Qwiic uses GPIO23/22.
GPIO32/33/25/26 support digital input and are not boot strapping pins.
Channels provide FULL ON/OFF and PWM but no digital inputs. Non-inverted totem-pole outputs reset LOW. All channels share frequency/OE/SLEEP/reset.
Manual header example: straight 2.54mm breakaway male strip cut to five positions; no SMT substitution.
Manual cable example: use five female/female 150mm jumpers from a strip; ESP32 requires matching male headers.

button_power: R16–R19 from /HOST_3V3; no local3V3 tie. Both Qwiic and GPIO cable required for valid button interface. Common GND.
multiple_boards: I2C addressing still uses external mux because MPRLS address is fixed. Each independent button bank needs four additional master GPIOs; mux does not switch those signals.
cost: Component count reduced by six net; no current total-cost saving claimed without supplier quote and cable/header costs.
